fixed_regressions: Grid snapping a parent could leave a child below its minimum when no inner grid line fit.
Incoherent centered trees or unoccupied non-centered branches could be accepted as saved distributions.
Restoring a distribution that did not fit could change model/preferences and report success.
verified_invariants: failed restore leaves model/preferences/pending work unchanged
scope_limits: multi-monitor and multi-Space combinations are modeled, not tested on the remote physical Mac
native diagnostics only read Accessibility/WindowServer state
